title: Latinus son of Vlysses
summary: Raleigh names Latinus son of Vlysses in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The third Latinus in Pomponius Sabinus his count of foure, the sonne of Vlysses by Circe. He is not Latinus the sonne of Faunus. The one-word title would fold onto latinus, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
